messages:
marie: FYI I opened a docs PR to update the model catalog entry for Solace-6B — limits, benchmark numbers, and compatibility notes for the new 4-bit quant variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1842

samir: Thanks — can you call out which quant profiles are supported? we should avoid implying GPU-only if CPU fallback is allowed.

marie: Good call. In the draft I added a Compatibility section saying: `quantized: q4_0, q4_1 (GPU recommended), q4_cpu_fallback` with a note that q4_cpu_fallback has reduced throughput.

jonathan: Quick ask from eng-ml: can you paste the micro-bench numbers you used? want to verify they match our bench harness.

marie: Pasted the trimmed output I used:```
bench run --model=solace-6b --seq=2048 --bs=8
throughput: 95.2 tokens/s per GPU
p95 latency: 220ms
mem peak: 11.3GB (fp16)
```

lina: For docs clarity, add a short snippet showing the SDK call and the variant name to use. e.g. `model: solace-6b:quant-q4_1`

marie: Added this example to the PR:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="solace-6b:quant-q4_1", prompt="Summarize...", max_tokens=150)
print(resp.text)
```

samir: Minor nit: update the limits table to show `max_sequence_length` = 8192 and `recommended_batch_size` = 8 for quant variants. Also mention the observed cold-start penalty for q4_cpu_fallback.

marie: Done — table updated and I added sentence about cold start: "cpu fallback may incur +300-600ms cold-start the first call while kernels JIT."

jonathan: One more: in the Benchmarks section, can you include the harness config (seed, tokenizer version) so we keep numbers reproducible?

marie: Yep added: `tokenizer: v3.4.1`, `seed: 42`, `beam: none`. Also linked the bench harness repo.

lina: LGTM from docs side if eng-ml signs off on numbers.

samir: I checked the bench numbers vs our harness. Numbers match within noise. approve from eng-ml :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #1842 merged into main by marie — changelog updated. :tada:

marie: Thanks all! I'll follow up with a tiny note for the model catalog index so the search tag "small-llm" includes Solace-6B.

lina: can someone add the migration note for customers switching from solace-6b:fp16 -> solace-6b:quant-q4_cpu_fallback? small checklist would help.

marie: Added a short migration checklist at the end of the card with recommended steps: backup prompt sets, test quality on a holdout, validate latency targets on a staging pool.

jonathan: Perfect. closing thread.
